Join Mo Pai Mahjong Club for an afternoon of mahjong and bold Hong Kong flavors in The Clubhouse while we listen to a curated playlist, snack, sip, and shuffle tiles.

🀄️ We will also be joined by Teasatia who will be providing whole-leaf tea samples to pair with your sweets.
🀄️ Please indicate your playing level in the questionnaire to help with assigned seating. We will have competitive tables playing for points, but are also opening it up to beginners. (Visual handouts will be provided.)
🀄️ Clubhouse password for entry will be shared the week of the event.
🀄️ All ticket sales are final. We are unable to issue refunds.

Looking forward to playing alongside you all in Chinatown this October!

event.title: Patchwork Show Oakland

The original alternative creative market in Southern California *and beyond. Est. 2007

Since 2007, Patchwork Show has been where creativity, community, and small business come together. What began as Orange County’s first alternative craft fair—a scrappy market in a Santa Ana parking lot—has grown into a multi-city festival celebrating local makers, food, music, and hands-on crafting.

Patchwork Show isn’t just a market—it’s an incubator for creative businesses and a space where connections are made and creativity thrives. Vendors grow their brands and followings, while attendees discover unique handmade goods and the people behind them.
Whether you’re here to shop, snack, or get inspired, Patchwork Show welcomes you with open arms. Because it’s not just about the goods—it’s about the community that brings them to life.

event.title: J.Ehren x HHM Fashion Show
event.description:
We are back! Join us for an unforgettable evening as fashion, art, and heritage come together inside a stunning ballroom in the heart of downtown San Francisco.

Held in honor of Hispanic Heritage Month, this runway show celebrates the diverse histories, traditions, and creative influence of Hispanic and Latino communities. Through an original collection, we explore the ways heritage can shape identity, artistry, and fashion.

Featuring a cast that centers Hispanic and Latino talent, the evening is an opportunity to spotlight voices that have long influenced the world around us while continuing to push for greater visibility within fashion.

Join us for a night of bold design, storytelling, and celebration as we honor Hispanic and Latino creativity and its place within San Francisco’s evolving fashion scene.

TICKETS

GENERAL ADMISSION:
Your ticket includes full access to the event and runway show. Enjoy an evening of fashion, art, music, and celebration as we honor Hispanic Heritage Month and the creativity of the communities we serve.

VIP EXPERIENCE:
VIP tickets come with resserved front row seating. More than an upgraded ticket, VIP is an opportunity to directly support the continuation of independent fashion events like this one. Your purchase helps J.EHREN continue producing accessible runway shows, creating opportunities for emerging creatives, and bringing fashion and community together throughout San Francisco.

By joining us as a VIP guest, you’re not only getting the best seat in the house—you’re helping us keep these experiences alive.

SPONSORED TICKETS: 
We believe everyone should have the opportunity to experience fashion, regardless of their financial circumstances. For this event, we are offering 20 complimentary tickets to guests who otherwise would not be able to attend due to cost.

These tickets are reserved for those who genuinely need the support and are offered on an honor system. If purchasing a ticket would prevent you from attending, we encourage you to reach out.

To receive access to the sponsored ticket promo code, please communicate directly with the event producer. This helps us ensure these limited tickets reach the people they are intended for.

No explanation or proof is required—just an honest request.

EVENT TIMELINE & TICKET POLICY:

6:30 PM — DOORS OPEN
Guests are invited to arrive, grab a drink, explore the space, and settle in before the show begins.

8:00 PM — RUNWAY SHOW
The main event begins.

9:00–10:00 PM — AFTER PARTY
Stay after the runway show to celebrate, connect, dance, and enjoy the final hour of the evening.

TICKET POLICY: 
All ticket sales are final and non-refundable. If you’re no longer able to attend, your ticket may be transferred to another guest. It is the ticket holder’s responsibility to find a replacement guest or buyer for their ticket. J.EHREN is not responsible for reselling tickets or finding a replacement on behalf of the ticket holder.

🎃 Glue Sticks & Guac: A Halloween Crafty Crew Fiesta 👻

Come join us for a spooky, crafty night of junk journaling, analog hobbies, good food, and good company! 🖤✨

We’re bringing the Crafty Crew together for a Halloween fiesta where all analog hobbies are welcome—junk journals, scrapbooking, collaging, paper crafts, happy mail, and whatever crafty obsession you’re currently into. Bring your current project, come make something new, or just come hang out and soak up the crafty chaos!

Your $12 ticket includes:
🍕 At least 2 slices of pizza
🥑 Chips & guacamole
🎟️ Lots of fun raffle opportunities
🎃 A Halloween Bingo game with prizes and surprises
✂️ A scrap pack to get those creative juices flowing

They have some amazing Mexican-style pizzas loaded with toppings, but since some of those toppings can be a little adventurous (hello, cilantro 😂), I’m putting together a selection that everyone can enjoy—including specialty pizzas + pepperoni.

And yes… there will absolutely be guac. Because obviously we couldn’t call it Glue Sticks & Guac without the guac! 😂🥑

Drinks are not included with the ticket. I wanted to leave drinks open so you can order whatever you actually want instead of being limited to a fountain soda. And if you haven’t tried their horchata yet… my daughter swears it’s the best around, so consider that your personal recommendation. 😉

👻 Costumes & Crafty Chaos

Costumes are totally encouraged, and we’ll be having a Halloween Costume Contest, so feel free to get creative!

Whether you’re coming dressed as a spooky little goblin, your favorite fictional character, a crafty witch, or just yourself with a glue stick in hand—we want you there.

It’s a Thursday night, I know! 🥹 But I’m really hoping you can make it. Come craft, eat, laugh, play bingo, win some raffles, and spend a few hours with your fellow crafty weirdos. 🖤🎃

Bring your project. Bring your scissors. Bring your glue. Bring your creativity.
We’ll bring the guac. 🥑✨
